newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil telecom bill faces lower house vote Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil telecom bill faces lower house vote Thurs.

text.p: The Brazilian Chamber of Deputies Wednesday approved a motion giving priority status to a bill that regulates the privatization of the telecommunications industry, a congressional official said.
Approval of the motion means the bill will probably be put to a vote on the floor of the lower house Thursday, the official said.
The Chamber of Deputies is currently restricted to dealing with the government's civil service reform bill but it may also vote on legislation classed as a priority.
The telecommuncations bill would set down rules for the privatization of the federally owned Telebras system, create a new regulator for the sector and establish rules for private operators.
The bill requires a straight majority in the Chamber of Deputies before moving on to the Senate.
